Package dev.px.core.event

Interface Listenable

All Known Implementing Classes:
ExampleKillAura, ExampleSprint, Module, ThreadedModule, Toggleable
public interface Listenable
Lets an object gate its own handlers without subscribing and unsubscribing.

Module implements this as its enabled flag, so a module is subscribed once at registration and its handlers simply go quiet while it is off. That keeps handler order stable across toggles and avoids the churn of re-scanning a class every time it is switched on.

Handlers annotated @Subscribe(ignoreListening = true) bypass this.
